name: Proto-Uralic (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Uralic is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Uralic family (Finnic, Samic, Ugric and the other branches). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Sammallahti, P.
sources.title: Historical phonology of the Uralic languages
sources.notes: Reference for Uralic branching (structural ancestry node only).
